title: Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine
abstract: arXiv:2611.31038v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow-matching policies integrate a velocity field from a fixed, observation-independent Gaussian source. However, since the source is unimodal and identical across all tasks, the limited representational capacity of Gaussian distributions constrains how far a policy can scale with growing task diversity. Moreover, the source factorizes over time steps and control dimensions, discarding the coordination that manipulation requires. We introduce Boltz-Flow, which replaces Gaussian initialization with a more powerful, observation- and instruction-conditioned Boltzmann source while leaving the base VLA unchanged. Boltz-Flow parameterizes this source with a conditional Boltzmann machine that assigns an energy value to each binary source state. A listwise objective, supervised entirely by offline demonstrations, aligns this energy with the quality of actions produced after frozen flow integration. translated_title: Boltz-Flow：从玻尔兹曼机生成高质量机器人动作
translated_abstract: 流匹配策略从固定的、与观测无关的高斯源出发积分速度场。然而，由于该源是单峰的且在所有任务中完全相同，高斯分布有限的表示能力限制了策略随任务多样性增长的可扩展性。此外，该源在时间步和控制维度上进行因子化分解，丢失了操作任务所需的协调性。我们提出Boltz-Flow，它用更强大的、以观测和指令为条件的玻尔兹曼源取代高斯初始化，同时保持基础VLA模型不变。Boltz-Flow通过一个条件玻尔兹曼机对该源进行参数化，为每个二进制源状态分配一个能量值。一个列表式目标函数完全由离线演示数据监督，使该能量与冻结流积分后产生的动作质量对齐。在推理阶段，该能量定义了一个伊辛模型实例……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Boltz-Flow，用观测和指令条件化的条件玻尔兹曼机取代流匹配策略中固定单峰的高斯初始源，突破高斯分布表示能力的限制并保留跨维度的动作协调性，从而在保持基础VLA模型冻结不变的情况下生成更高质量的机器人操作动作。
